opportunities.title: 3D Printed Cigar Tuck Cutter
opportunities.description: I’m developing a hand-powered tuck cutter that lets me press natural tobacco leaf wrappers onto a flat surface and quickly trim them with a clean, curved edge perfect for rolling cigars. I need a CAD design that I can send straight to my 3D-printer—no further tweaking—so attention to tolerances and blade alignment is essential. Because I work exclusively with whole, natural leaves, the geometry must accommodate their slight stretch while still producing a consistent rounded cut. The tool will be operated solely by hand; no clamps, hinges, or tabletop mounts are required, but an ergonomic grip and enough rigidity to prevent flex while pressing are important. Deliverables • Print-ready STL (plus STEP or native Fusion 360/SolidWorks file for future edits) • Exploded view or brief assembly note if multiple printed parts are involved • Recommended material settings (layer height, infill, orientation) to preserve edge sharpness • Confirmation that the cutting profile produces a smooth, curved strip the full width of a cigar wrapper I’ll test the first print and share feedback; quick revisions to fine-tune fit or edge profile may follow. Let’s create a simple, durable cutter that speeds up my rolling workflow and looks good on the bench.

opportunities.title: People Like Us - chat room website/app
opportunities.description: # Build a Website – People Like Us I want to build a social chat platform called **People Like Us**. The idea is simple: People can register, find chat rooms based on their interests and communicate with like-minded people. Think of WhatsApp groups, but with public rooms that anyone can join. The website should be very simple and easy to use, even for people who aren't tech-savvy. ### Main Features 1. **Registration:** Users can create accounts and profiles. 2. **Public Chat Rooms:** Different rooms for Startups, Business Ideas, Making Money, Dating, Jokes, Technology, Fitness and other interests. Anyone registered can join any public room. 3. **Private Chat Rooms:** Users can create private rooms and invite other people to discuss ideas. No fixed membership limit. 4. **Direct Messages:** Users can privately message anyone on the platform. 5. **Messaging:** Text messages, photos, videos and document sharing. 6. **Message Controls:** Users can edit and delete their messages, reply to messages and search conversations. 7. **Room Discovery:** Search and explore rooms based on interests. 8. **Notifications:** Notify users about new messages, replies and mentions. 9. **Moderation:** Users can report spam or inappropriate behaviour. Admins can review reports and block accounts when necessary. 10. **Admin Dashboard:** I should be able to manage users, rooms, reports and the overall platform. ### Donation System The platform will be completely free. There will be no subscription or joining fees. I want a voluntary donation button so people can support the platform. Donors can optionally display their name, photo and a short story about what they achieved through the platform. Donation amounts will always remain private. ### Design I want a modern, attractive and very simple interface, similar to WhatsApp in ease of use. The website should work smoothly on computers and mobile phones. ### Important The platform should be built with scalability in mind because I eventually want thousands or millions of users. I want complete ownership of the website, source code, database and hosting accounts. Please share your previous work, estimated development cost and time required to complete this project.

opportunities.title: Lead-Focused Interior Reels Strategy
opportunities.description: Launching a premium interior-design styling consultancy, my first priority is converting Instagram and Facebook messages into booked consultations. Every Reel, carousel, or Story must spotlight our design process, materials, and behind-the-scenes thinking—using only select project images—to convey the ideology that sets us apart, then guide viewers straight to a WhatsApp chat for next-step discussions. You’ll own the pipeline from concept to conversion: develop monthly creative themes, direct or repurpose footage, edit in CapCut, Premiere Rush, or equivalent, write persuasive captions and hashtags, schedule through Meta Business Suite, and manage comments and DMs until they become warm leads. Interior-styling fluency is essential; the content has to sound as informed about marble veins and lighting temperatures as it is about algorithm trends. Monthly deliverables • 12 vertical Reels and 8 carousel/static posts, export-ready in the required ratios • Copy for captions, Stories, and automated replies, each CTA linking to WhatsApp • Lead-tracking sheet showing message volume, response times, and consultations booked • Performance report covering reach, engagement, saves, and conversion rate If you have proven results driving consultations for design or lifestyle brands, share links and metrics so I can gauge how your strategy could elevate this new venture.

opportunities.title: WhatsApp Business API Debugging
opportunities.description: I need an experienced developer to jump into my existing WhatsApp Business API setup, trace whatever is blocking it, and get everything flowing smoothly again. At the moment the integration is unreliable—sometimes messages never leave, delivery callbacks stall, and the API connection occasionally drops. I’m looking for someone who can isolate the root cause, patch the code or server configuration as needed, and prove stability with real-world tests. To keep us aligned, here’s what I expect you to hand over: • Fully functional send-and-receive cycle verified with test numbers • Webhook events firing consistently for all message statuses • Clean, well-commented code or configuration notes outlining the fix • Quick guide summarising any credentials, endpoints, or tokens I must refresh You may work in the language or framework of your choice—as long as it works with Meta’s current Business Cloud API specs—and can run on my cloud host. Please outline your relevant experience with WhatsApp Business API, signal how soon you can begin, and tell me roughly how long the full diagnostic and repair should take.

opportunities.title: Build PalmStudio’s High-Impact Agency Website
opportunities.description: We are looking for a talented and experienced Website Designer and Developer to create a modern, professional and visually impressive website for our creative agency, PalmStudio. PalmStudio is a creative digital agency offering a range of services designed to help businesses build stronger brands, establish their online presence and grow through innovative digital solutions. We want a website that reflects our creativity, professionalism and expertise while positioning PalmStudio as a trusted agency for businesses looking for reliable design, development and digital services. The primary goal of this website is to attract potential clients, showcase our services, generate enquiries and convert visitors into paying customers. Project Requirements We need a complete, responsive and professionally designed agency website that includes the following pages and features: 1. Homepage * Modern, eye-catching and professional homepage. * Strong headline communicating our value proposition. * Clear introduction to PalmStudio. * Overview of our main services. * Strong calls to action encouraging visitors to get in touch. * Client-focused messaging that highlights the value we provide. 2. About Us * Professional introduction to PalmStudio. * Our mission, vision and approach. * What makes our agency different. * A section highlighting our commitment to quality and client satisfaction. 3. Services Page Create dedicated service sections showcasing our offerings: * Website Design & Full-Stack Development. * Branding & Creative Design. * AI Integration & Business Automation. * Mobile App & Game Development. * Digital Marketing & Advertising. * Business & Digital Management Services. Each service should have a professional description explaining how it benefits potential clients. 4. Portfolio / Our Work * Visually appealing project showcase. * Professional project mockups and presentations. * Space to display website designs, branding projects, applications and creative work. * Individual project descriptions where appropriate. 5. Contact / Get a Quote * Professional contact form. * Project enquiry form. * Email contact details. * Clear calls to action. * Easy communication options for prospective clients. Design & Functionality Requirements We want a website that is: * Modern, creative and visually distinctive. * Professional and suitable for an international audience. * Clean, intuitive and easy to navigate. * Fully responsive across desktop, tablet and mobile. * Fast-loading and performance-optimised. * SEO-friendly. * Designed with user experience and conversions in mind. * Consistent with PalmStudio’s branding and visual identity. We are particularly interested in creative layouts, high-quality typography, subtle animations, engaging visuals and polished website interactions. Preferred Technologies We are open to recommendations but would prefer someone experienced with: * WordPress, Webflow or custom website development. * HTML, CSS and JavaScript. * React, Next.js or other modern frameworks. * Figma for design and prototyping. * SEO and website optimisation. Deliverables The successful freelancer will be expected to provide: * Complete website design and development. * All agreed website pages and functionality. * Responsive mobile and tablet versions. * Contact and enquiry form integration. * Basic on-page SEO setup. * Website testing and quality assurance. * Website source files and relevant assets. * Website deployment and handover. * Basic instructions for managing website content. Ideal Freelancer We are looking for someone who: * Has proven experience designing professional agency websites. * Can demonstrate a strong portfolio. * Has excellent UI/UX design skills. * Understands how to design websites that generate leads. * Has strong attention to detail. * Communicates clearly throughout the project. * Can work independently and meet agreed deadlines. Budget & Timeline We are open to receiving competitive proposals based on your experience, portfolio and proposed approach. Please include your estimated project cost and delivery timeline when applying. How to Apply Please provide: 1. Your portfolio showcasing relevant agency or business websites. 2. Examples of websites you have designed and developed. 3. Your recommended platform and technology. 4. Your estimated project cost. 5. Your expected delivery timeframe. 6. A brief explanation of how you would approach this project. We are looking for a creative professional who can transform our vision into a polished digital experience that represents PalmStudio and helps us attract and convert new clients.

opportunities.title: Long-Term 2D Design Partner
opportunities.description: I’m setting up a three-year collaboration with one versatile designer who can turn a constant stream of ideas, sketches, and mark-ups into crisp, presentation-ready 2D drawings and designs. Most weeks I’ll hand you rough hand-sketches, photo references, or red-lined PDFs and ask for clean, scaled drawings that are accurate enough for engineers yet attractive enough for client decks. The work is varied—one month it may be detailed building layouts, the next a set of technical product diagrams or marketing visuals—so fluency across common 2D toolsets is essential. AutoCAD for precise line work, Adobe Illustrator or Photoshop for polished graphics, and the ability to export everything to whatever final format the project dictates (print-ready PDFs, layered source files, or native CAD) keeps the pipeline flowing smoothly. Communication and consistency matter more than flashy portfolios. I value: • Fast, reliable turnarounds within agreed timelines • Clearly organised layers, styles, and naming conventions • Easy revision cycles: you accept mark-ups, return updated files, and note what changed • A proactive eye for detail—spotting dimension clashes or layout issues before they become problems Although the bulk of the load is 2D, a comfort level with quick 3D mock-ups or renders is a welcome bonus and could grow into a larger part of the role as our product lines evolve. If you’re ready for steady, predictable work and enjoy refining drawings until they’re spot-on, let’s talk about the first assignment and set milestones for the months ahead.

opportunities.title: Java Selenium Task Automation
opportunities.description: I need a clean, well-structured Java + Selenium script that reliably automates a handful of routine actions on a web portal I use every day. The workflow looks like this: • Sign in with standard credentials, then capture and submit the one-time code the site emails or texts to complete authentication. • Navigate through several pages, populate and submit a set of forms, and trigger the required uploads or downloads. • Extract specific data points from the resulting pages and save them locally as CSV or JSON so I can feed them into another system. A headless option is preferred so the job can later run on a small server, but I still want to be able to toggle a visible browser while we fine-tune selectors. Please keep the code modular—separate login, form-fill, file transfer, and data-harvest steps—so I can reuse pieces when the site layout changes. Clear comments and a brief README that explains how to adjust locators, credentials, and storage paths will be enough for documentation. Acceptance criteria • End-to-end run completes without manual input, including OTP capture handled through IMAP/POP3 or a lightweight SMS-to-email gateway I’ll provide. • All targeted files land in the designated folder, and scraped values match the on-screen data. • Java 11+ and the latest stable Selenium WebDriver; Maven or Gradle build. • Code passes on both Windows and Linux with only config tweaks. Once the script hits those marks, I’ll integrate it into a larger scheduler, so please design with easy parameterization in mind.
opportunities.contractor_info: Demandante verificado en Freelancer.co (Anuncio #40818726, publicado hace 6 horas (hoy)). Presupuesto ofrecido: INR 750 - 1,250.

opportunities.title: Recover & Convert WhatsApp/Viber Audio
opportunities.description: I need a specialist who can dig into an Android device that I have fully unlocked, locate every trace of cleared-out voice notes from both WhatsApp and Viber, and hand them back to me as individual, clearly labeled MP3 files. The phone is in my possession and can be connected to a computer; no iCloud or other ecosystem is involved, so the entire recovery will revolve around on-device folders and any local backup archives that may still exist. Here is what the job entails from my side: • You will connect to the handset only while it is in my view (USB debugging or ADB pull, whichever you prefer) and work in an isolated, offline workspace. • Typical tools you might rely on—ADB, Android Studio file explorer, SQLite viewers for the message databases, plus FFmpeg or sox for audio conversion—are all acceptable as long as everything stays local. • Once you have extracted the original .opus or .ogg clips, convert each one to MP3 without transcoding loss that would hurt audibility; I expect normal speech to be crisp and free of artifacts. • Keep logs minimal, strip personal identifiers in any script outputs, and delete every copy of the raw data as soon as I acknowledge safe receipt. Deliverables - A folder (zipped) containing the recovered, correctly named MP3 files for both WhatsApp and Viber. - A brief plain-text note outlining the exact folders, commands, and checksums you used so I can reproduce or audit the process later. If you have completed similar Android WhatsApp or Viber recoveries before, describe your usual workflow and any privacy safeguards you apply—this will help me choose swiftly.

opportunities.title: Daily Metrics Excel Automation
opportunities.description: Every morning I download raw operational data, move columns around, apply look-ups, then copy the results into a master sheet so the team can see the day’s numbers. I want that entire routine turned into a single, push-button Excel workbook. Here’s what the finished file should do each day: • Pull the newest raw file from a designated folder—whether it arrives as .xlsx, .csv, or a system export. • Clean, reformat, and validate the data exactly the way I do it now. • Recalculate my key daily metrics (sales, orders, inventory turns, staffing hours, etc.) and flag any outliers. • Present the refreshed numbers on a clear summary tab that’s ready to print or email. • Archive a time-stamped copy automatically so nothing is lost. Power Query, VBA, dynamic arrays, or a mix of those tools are fine as long as the solution runs in standard Excel without extra licences. Accuracy must match my current manual totals—no rounding surprises. Deliverables 1. Automated workbook with all import, transformation, and reporting logic in place. 2. A brief hand-off guide or short screencast explaining how to refresh and adjust the file in the future. I’ll share sample exports and my existing tracker once we start. Let me know your turnaround time and anything else you need from me so we can get this automation in place quickly.

opportunities.title: Full Home Automation System Design
opportunities.description: I need a full, end-to-end design for a residential automation system that puts intelligent lighting and climate control at its core. The project should map out how every switch, dimmer, sensor, thermostat, and actuator ties into a single backbone, ensuring seamless daylight-responsive dimming, scene presets, and temperature scheduling that adapts room-by-room. Alongside comfort control, I want the plan to incorporate two key security layers: smart cameras with motion-triggered alerts and smart door locks that let me manage visitor access rules centrally. All interaction will happen through elegant wall-mounted touch panels, so the design must specify hardware locations, interface flow, and the low-latency network needed to keep every screen snappy. Please deliver • System architecture diagram showing hubs, panels, and device endpoints • Wiring / network schematics ready for an electrician or low-voltage contractor • Bill of materials with model numbers for lighting modules, thermostats, cameras, locks, panels, and any required gateways • Touch-panel UI mock-ups that illustrate lighting scenes, climate set points, camera views, and lock status • Integration notes (e.g., KNX, Zigbee, Z-Wave, or IP) and configuration steps so an installer can bring the system online without guesswork The house is new-build, so you can assume clean-sheet cabling is possible. Keep the design modular so additional smart appliances or voice assistants could be added later, but focus your detail on the scope above.
opportunities.contractor_info: Demandante verificado en Freelancer.co (Anuncio #40818717, publicado hace 6 horas (hoy)). Presupuesto ofrecido: USD 30 - 250.

opportunities.title: Launch a Premium Digital Product Brand
opportunities.description: # Experienced Digital Product Business Builder – Product Research, Creation & Premium E-commerce Website I am looking for an experienced freelancer or a small team that has previously built and launched successful digital-product businesses. **My objective is to launch a digital-product brand within 24 hours.** I am not looking for someone who only designs PDFs, creates ebooks or develops websites. I need someone who understands the entire digital-product business model, from product research to product creation, website development, payment integration and conversion tracking. ## 1. Product research Research and shortlist 10 digital products with demonstrated demand in the Indian market. Focus on: - Career and job preparation kits - AI business toolkits - Instagram and social media templates - Excel and Google Sheets toolkits - Small business launch guides - Productivity templates - Digital cookbooks - Kids' educational worksheets - Freelancer business toolkits - Other validated digital products Target selling price: ₹599–₹799. Provide competitor examples, pricing, target customers, product differentiation and evidence of demand. Do not simply generate generic ChatGPT ebooks. ## 2. Digital product development Select the best three products based on research and create complete, premium-quality digital products. Each product should include: - Professionally designed PDF/workbook. - Practical templates and downloadable resources. - Original, useful and actionable content. - Premium cover design. - Product preview images. - Clear product descriptions. - Bonus materials wherever relevant. I want products that customers genuinely find useful and worth paying ₹699–₹799 for. ## 3. Website development Build a premium, modern, minimalistic digital-product e-commerce website. The website must have: - Clean and professional homepage. - Premium product cards. - Individual product pages. - Mobile-first responsive design. - Secure checkout. - UPI, Google Pay, PhonePe and card payment support. - Automatic digital product delivery after successful payment. - Automated order confirmation emails. - Coupon and bundle functionality. - Admin dashboard to manage products and orders. The website should look like a professionally established digital brand, not a generic template website. ## 4. Marketing and analytics setup Set up: - Meta Pixel. - Conversion API wherever supported. - Google Analytics. - Purchase conversion tracking. - Add-to-cart tracking. - Checkout tracking. - Campaign attribution. - Basic email automation. opportunities.title: One Hour Blender Animation Lesson
opportunities.description: In a single, live one-hour session over screen-share, I want to get comfortable with Blender’s animation basics. Blender 5.2 is already installed on my laptop; what I need now is practical, guided practice. The focus of the lesson is creating basic animations—specifically moving and rotating simple objects. Please walk me through the essential workspace controls, keyframing, and the timeline so that by the end of the hour I can confidently set up and play a short object-motion sequence on my own. We can meet through Zoom, Google Meet, or any similar tool that allows screen sharing and clear audio. I’ll share my screen so you can demonstrate each step directly within my own Blender interface and watch me repeat it. By the end of the call, I expect to: • Understand how to navigate the viewport and manipulate objects. • Animate at least one object’s position and rotation from start to finish. • Export or preview the result smoothly. If you have sample .blend files that illustrate object motion, feel free to bring them; otherwise we’ll create a scene from scratch.

opportunities.title: Especialista en Gohighlevel para crear una máquina de ventas y Crm ...
opportunities.description: Se busca un especialista con experiencia comprobable en GoHighLevel para desarrollar una máquina de ventas y CRM integral para una correduría de seguros en Colombia. El objetivo es construir una plataforma robusta que no solo funcione como CRM administrativo, sino que también automatice la captación, calificación y distribución de prospectos, con la capacidad de ser replicada para otras agencias de seguros. Los componentes clave a desarrollar incluyen: 1. Captación y embudo de ventas: - Diseño e implementación de landing pages de calificación y páginas de agradecimiento. - Configuración de formularios conectados a campañas de anuncios en Meta (Facebook/Instagram). - Creación de un pipeline de ventas con etapas definidas: prospecto, contactado, cotizado, negociación, ganado/perdido. 2. Agente de IA para WhatsApp: - Desarrollo de un agente de inteligencia artificial capaz de responder a prospectos en segundos, calificarlos y agendar citas automáticamente. - Implementación de lógica para transferir leads 'calientes' a un asesor humano. 3. Distribución automática de prospectos: - Configuración de un sistema de asignación de leads tipo 'round-robin' o por turnos entre asesores o agentes. - Establecimiento de reglas de distribución basadas en el ramo de seguro (vida, salud, autos, hogar, exequias, etc.), Ubicación geográfica o disponibilidad del asesor. - Asegurar la no duplicación de leads, con notificaciones automáticas vía WhatsApp a los asesores y seguimiento en tiempo real. - Posibilidad de establecer límites de leads por asesor o paquete. 4. CRM de clientes y pólizas: - Creación de fichas de cliente detalladas que incluyan información de pólizas, aseguradora, ramo, vigencia, prima y estado. - Implementación de campos personalizados y alertas de renovación (60, 30 y 15 días antes). - Funcionalidades para el manejo de cartera, incluyendo recordatorios de pago y seguimiento de cobro. 5. Automatizaciones y flujos de trabajo: - Desarrollo de secuencias automatizadas de WhatsApp, SMS y correo electrónico para bienvenida, seguimiento, post-venta, renovación y reactivación. - Configuración de recordatorios de citas (24 horas, 1 hora, 10 minutos antes). - Creación de flujos de correo con plantillas personalizables. 6. Informes y dashboards: - Generación de informes y paneles de control para visualizar leads por fuente, tasa de conversión por etapa, ventas por asesor/ramo, estado de cartera, renovaciones y comisiones. 7. Modelo multi-agencia: - Estructuración del sistema para permitir la creación de subcuentas o 'snapshots' que faciliten la replicación del sistema a otras agencias de seguros, permitiendo la administración independiente de cada una. Se requiere experiencia sólida en la configuración de workflows, pipelines, agentes de IA e integraciones dentro de la plataforma GoHighLevel. Categoría: Programación y Tecnología Subcategoría: Programación Web ¿Cuál es el alcance del proyecto?: Crear un nuevo sitio personalizado

opportunities.title: B2B Sales Executive for AI Websites
opportunities.description: # Hiring: Freelance Sales & Business Development Executive – Website Development & AI Automation Services ### About the project We are building a digital solutions agency that helps small and medium-sized businesses (SMEs) establish and improve their online presence through professional websites and AI-powered business automation. We are looking for an experienced freelance Sales & Business Development Executive who can independently identify potential customers, contact business owners, explain our services, understand their requirements, and convert interested prospects into qualified sales opportunities. **This is NOT a simple lead-generation or data-entry assignment.** We do not want Excel sheets filled with random business names, phone numbers or email addresses. We want someone who can actually speak with business owners, understand their requirements, discuss our pricing, and obtain clear confirmation that they are interested in purchasing our services. ### 1. What services will you be selling? We offer website development packages ranging from ₹15,000 to ₹50,000, depending on the complexity and features required. Our offering goes beyond conventional website development. We provide professional websites integrated with AI-powered features and business automation. **Our services include:** **A. Professional website development** - Business websites - Company profile websites - Product and service catalogue websites - Landing pages - Portfolio websites - E-commerce websites (where applicable) **B. AI-powered website automation** - AI chatbot integrated into the website - Automated responses to customer enquiries - AI-powered website visitor engagement - Automated lead capture - AI voice calling capabilities, where suitable - Automated follow-up workflows **C. Appointment and booking automation** - Online appointment booking - Calendar integration - Automated booking confirmations - Appointment reminders - Customer enquiry management **D. Business automation** - WhatsApp integration - Contact form automation - CRM integration - Lead management - Customer notification workflows - Other relevant AI integrations based on business requirements The exact features and integrations will depend on the customer's requirements and the selected package. ### 2. Target customers You will identify and approach small and medium-sized businesses that either: - Do not currently have a professional website. - Have an outdated or poorly functioning website. - Depend heavily on WhatsApp or phone calls for customer enquiries. - Want to automate customer interactions. - Need appointment booking or enquiry management. - Want to improve their digital presence and generate more business online. **Target industries include:** 1. Clinics, dental hospitals and diagnostic centres. 2. Manufacturers and industrial suppliers. 3. Distributors and wholesalers. 4. Interior designers and architects. 5. Real estate agencies and property consultants. 6. Educational institutions and coaching centres. 7. Restaurants, cafes and hospitality businesses. 8. Travel agencies and tour operators. 9. Consultants and professional service providers. 10. Other SMEs with a genuine need for websites and business automation. You can identify prospects through Google Maps, Google Search, LinkedIn, business directories, Instagram and other legitimate sources. Initially, focus on Bengaluru, Hyderabad and other major Indian cities. We are open to customers across India. ### 3. Your actual responsibilities Your responsibility is to manage the entire prospecting and initial sales qualification process. **Step 1: Identify potential customers** Find businesses that genuinely need a website or AI-powered website automation. Research their existing online presence before contacting them. **Step 2: Contact business owners** You must personally speak with business owners, founders, decision-makers or authorised representatives. You can use: - Phone calls - WhatsApp - Email - LinkedIn - Other appropriate communication channels Simply sending bulk WhatsApp messages or emails will not qualify as successful outreach. **Step 3: Explain our offering** Explain how we can help their business through: - A professional website - AI chatbot integration - Automated customer enquiry handling - Appointment booking - WhatsApp integration - Lead capture and follow-up automation Understand their actual business problem instead of giving everyone the same sales pitch. **Step 4: Discuss the budget** Our website development packages start at ₹15,000 and go up to ₹50,000. You must communicate this pricing range clearly. Do not submit prospects who are only looking for free websites or extremely low-cost development. Understand their budget and the features they are interested in purchasing. **Step 5: Obtain confirmation** This is the most important responsibility. Before submitting a prospect, you must establish that: - You have spoken directly with the business owner or decision-maker. - They have understood our website and automation offering. - They have expressed a genuine intention to purchase. - They are comfortable with a starting budget of ₹15,000 or more. - They have explained what kind of website or automation they require. - They have agreed to a next step, such as a discovery call, proposal discussion or meeting with our team. Where possible, obtain explicit WhatsApp or email confirmation of their interest. Never mark someone as qualified simply because they said they might need a website someday. ### 4. What counts as a qualified lead? A lead will only be accepted if it satisfies the following criteria: | Qualification | Requirement | |---|---| | Business | Genuine, operating business | | Contact | Owner or decision-maker contacted | | Requirement | Specific website/automation requirement identified | | Budget | Comfortable with ₹15,000–₹50,000 range | | Intent | Explicitly interested in purchasing | | Timeline | Wants to proceed within 30–60 days | | Confirmation | Agreed to a follow-up or discovery meeting | **Important:** A business that merely shares its contact number, receives a message or expresses vague interest is NOT a qualified lead. ### 5. Excel reporting requirements You must maintain a structured Excel or Google Sheets tracker. Every qualified prospect must have the following information: 1. Business name 2. Industry 3. City 4. Business website (if available) 5. Contact person's name 6. Contact person's designation 7. Phone number 8. WhatsApp number 9. Email address 10. Existing website status 11. Specific website requirement 12. AI automation features required 13. Customer's estimated budget 14. Expected purchase timeline 15. Date of conversation 16. Summary of the actual conversation 17. Confirmation received (Yes/No) 18. WhatsApp/email confirmation or evidence reference, where available 19. Agreed next action 20. Scheduled meeting date and time, if applicable 21. Current sales status Every submitted lead must contain meaningful qualification notes. We should be able to read the Excel sheet and understand exactly why that business wants a website, what it is willing to pay and when it intends to purchase. ### 6. Expected performance For the initial trial: - Research and identify relevant SME businesses. - Personally contact at least 20–30 businesses per working day. - Aim for 5–10 meaningful business-owner conversations per day. - Target 3–5 genuinely qualified prospects per week. These are initial performance targets, not permission to submit unqualified leads just to meet a number. Quality of leads matters significantly more than quantity. ### 7. Compensation We are open to discussing a combination of: - A small fixed monthly payment or weekly retainer. - Performance-based commission for every accepted, qualified prospect. - Additional incentives for customers who convert into paying clients. Please mention your expected compensation structure in your proposal. We prefer a performance-oriented arrangement. ### 8. Skills required - Previous experience in B2B sales or business development. - Comfortable making outbound phone calls. - Ability

opportunities.title: Build Hyperlocal Delivery Platform
opportunities.description: *The Last Shop* In 2031, Joseph closed his shop in Maralal town. Not because he was bankrupt - because rent was finally higher than his profit. For 11 years he had sold phones, chargers, gas cylinders, and unga. Then the apps came. People could order from Nairobi and it would arrive in two days for cheaper. He couldn't compete with a warehouse. He had 212,000 shillings left. He sat with it for a week. Instead of restocking, he did something his friends called stupid. He took his shop's name - "JOSKA ELECTRONICS & GENERAL" - and paid a guy in Nakuru 15,000 shillings to build him a simple system. The system was this: Anyone in Samburu North with a phone could send a WhatsApp message "NITUMIE GAS" and a rider would deliver. He didn't buy gas. He made a deal with 4 other shops that still had gas in stock. "You keep the stock, I bring the customer. You give me 200 shillings per delivery." He took his 212k and didn't buy inventory. He bought 2 second-hand Boxer motorbikes and hired two riders who had lost jobs as boda operators. Month 1: 14 orders a day. He made 2,800 shillings daily. Barely survival. Month 3: He added a trick. He started recording voice notes in Samburu language. "Mama, your gas will finish tomorrow based on last time, should we bring?" People started replying "yes" because he remembered for them. Orders jumped to 43 a day. Month 7: The hotels called. Lodges around Samburu Reserve hated sending their staff 2 hours to town for vegetables, soap, spare parts. Joseph became their procurement guy. One lodge = 80,000 shillings a month, guaranteed. Month 14: He stopped being a shop. He had 11 riders, a small dark store with no customers allowed inside - only fast-moving stock - and a dashboard on an old laptop showing every order, every rider, every repeat customer. A company from Nairobi came to "expand to Maralal" with millions in funding. They left after 4 months. They didn't understand that in Maralal, business is not done on an app. It's done on trust, on a voice note, on knowing that Mama Lekupe's grandson is sick so she needs credit for two days. By 2034, JOSKA wasn't an electronics shop. It was the logistics layer for a whole county. Joseph owned no shops, but every shop needed him. He didn't fight the future by trying to be bigger. He grew by being closer. That is how future business wins - not by owning everything, but by being the connection that technology alone cannot replace.

opportunities.title: AI Face Replacement with Lip-Sync
opportunities.description: I have a 20-minute talk, “Who Am I? – What Shapes Our Life” (https://youtu.be/x_Zn4ilnJrM), where my on-camera image is disappointingly low-res. I’ve already produced a crisp AI render of myself and want that version to appear every time I’m on screen—throughout the entire video—while the background and framing stay exactly as recorded. What I need: • Track my face in all shots and replace it with the supplied AI portrait. • Lip movements, micro-expressions, and timing must match the original speech as closely as possible so the swap is unnoticeable. • Keep audio, pacing, and all other visual elements intact. Deliverables: • Final 1080p (or higher) video with the new face seamlessly integrated. • Project file or layered comp so I can adjust captions later if needed. I will provide the AI image plus any reference frames the moment we start. Please outline briefly which tools or workflow you’ll use (e.g., DeepFaceLab, Runway, After Effects + tracking suite) and how long you’ll need once assets are in hand. I’m keen to begin right away.
opportunities.contractor_info: Demandante verificado en Freelancer.co (Anuncio #40818599, publicado hace 9 horas (hoy)). Presupuesto ofrecido: USD 10 - 30.

Key requirements: - Accurate 3D representation of a modern minimalist design. - Complete walkthrough of the entire home, including all indoor and outdoor areas. - High-quality textures and lighting to enhance realism. opportunities.title: Modelado Panda Blender + Vídeo
opportunities.description: Necesito un panda 3D en Blender que se parezca a la imagen de referencia: formas limpias pero con rasgos visibles en cara y cuerpo (orejas, ojos, hocico, manchas y extremidades bien definidas). Durante el proceso quiero que grabes la pantalla para que pueda ver cada paso. El vídeo debe mostrar: • Modelado completo del cuerpo • Asignación de materiales y colores básicos • Configuración de iluminación • Render final del resultado Entregables finales: • Archivo .blend con la escena organizada y sin enlaces rotos • Vídeo del proceso (formato MP4 preferido), de inicio a render, sin cortes críticos y a velocidad normal o ligeramente acelerada para mantener la claridad Prefiero una topología limpia y un orden lógico de capas/colecciones dentro del proyecto. Agradeceré comentarios en el vídeo o notas dentro del archivo si utilizas atajos o técnicas particulares.

opportunities.title: App móvil venta productos
opportunities.description: Quiero lanzar una aplicación móvil que me permita vender productos físicos de forma sencilla y segura. La idea es que el usuario pueda explorar un catálogo, añadir artículos al carrito, pagar dentro de la app y luego hacer seguimiento de su pedido. Me muevo con rapidez y disfruto de la tecnología, por lo que busco un desarrollo limpio, escalable y bien documentado. Funcionalidades clave • Catálogo con fotos, descripciones y stock en tiempo real • Carrito de compras y proceso de checkout optimizado • Pasarela de pago segura (tarjeta y, si es posible, billeteras digitales) • Notificaciones push para confirmar pedidos y actualizaciones de envío • Panel de administración para gestionar inventario, precios y promociones • Módulo de seguimiento de pedidos con número de guía • Estadísticas básicas de ventas y clientes Alcance técnico Prefiero una solución multiplataforma (Flutter o React Native) para publicar tanto en iOS como en Android, pero acepto propuestas nativas si justifican ventajas claras. El código debe quedar en un repositorio Git, acompañado de instrucciones de despliegue y un breve manual de usuario interno. Entregables 1. Código fuente completo y documentado 2. Build firmada lista para App Store y Google Play 3. Panel de administración funcional (puede ser web) 4. Archivo de configuración y guía de instalación Valoro la comunicación ágil, los commits frecuentes y la posibilidad de añadir funciones extra más adelante (por ejemplo, cupones o programa de fidelidad). Si tienes experiencia en e-commerce móvil y pasarelas de pago, será un plus importante.

opportunities.title: Descompilar y recompilar juego Gamebryo
opportunities.description: Cuento con el ejecutable original de un juego de mi infancia basado en Gamebryo con DirectX 9. Antes de empezar a retocar textos, gráficos o mecánicas, lo primero que necesito es un flujo estable de ingeniería inversa: obtener el código fuente legible, reorganizarlo en un proyecto que compile sin errores y generar un nuevo .exe funcional que se comporte exactamente igual que el original. Proporciono el .exe y los recursos actuales; también tengo identificadas varias DLL asociadas al motor. El objetivo inicial es: • Descompilar completamente el binario y cualquier librería vinculada • Reestructurar y documentar el proyecto de modo que pueda abrirse y compilarse en un entorno moderno (Visual Studio + SDK DirectX 9, por ejemplo) • Entregar un build reproducible con instrucciones paso a paso y las herramientas empleadas Cuando el re-ensamblado sea fiable, planeo avanzar hacia la localización de textos y ajustes ligeros, por lo que valoraré un código claro, comentarios donde se descubran offsets críticos y scripts que automaticen el proceso. Aprecio experiencia previa con Gamebryo, IDA Pro, Ghidra o herramientas similares, pero lo importante es obtener un proyecto mantenible y una compilación idéntica al ejecutable original.

opportunities.title: Roblox Multiplayer Kart Battle Game
opportunities.description: Hi, I want to develop a complete 3D multiplayer kart battle game on Roblox, inspired by the gameplay style of Smash Karts. I am looking for a fully functional, polished and monetizable Roblox game, not just a basic prototype. ### 1. Core Gameplay - Players drive customizable karts in an arena. - Multiplayer battles with real players. - Each match should support approximately 8–12 players. - Players collect random weapons and power-ups from boxes around the map. - Players attack opponents using different weapons. - Players earn kills, points and rewards. - Match timer, scoreboard and winner announcement. ### 2. Weapons and Power-ups Include multiple weapons, such as: - Rockets - Machine guns - Bombs - Mines - Homing missiles - Speed boosts - Shield protection - Special abilities Each weapon should have unique effects, animations and damage mechanics. ### 3. Maps and Arenas I want at least 3 unique battle arenas at launch. Examples: - Desert Arena - Neon City Arena - Tropical Island Arena Each map should have obstacles, ramps, weapon pickup locations and different environments. ### 4. Kart System - Multiple kart designs. - Smooth driving controls. - Acceleration, braking and drifting. - Kart customization. - Different kart skins. - Responsive mobile and PC controls. ### 5. Multiplayer and Matchmaking - Multiplayer matchmaking. - Waiting lobby. - Automatic match starting. - Player respawning. - Match results. - Leaderboards. - Proper server-side validation to prevent exploits. ### 6. Progression and Monetization - Coins and XP. - Daily rewards. - Missions and achievements. - Kart skins and customization. - Game passes. - Developer products. - Premium cosmetic items. The game must support Roblox's monetization system. ### 7. UI/UX I want a modern, polished interface: - Main menu. - Play button. - Garage. - Shop. - Inventory. - Missions. - Settings. - Matchmaking screen. - In-game scoreboard. - Results screen. ### 8. Technical Requirements - Entire game must be developed in Roblox Studio. - Clean and organized Luau scripts. - Proper server-client architecture. - DataStore saving system. - Optimized for PC, mobile and tablet. - No major bugs or broken features. - Proper testing before delivery. ### 9. Deliverables I require: 1. Complete playable Roblox game. 2. Full Roblox Studio project/source files. 3. All scripts and assets used. 4. Working multiplayer systems. 5. Documentation for important systems. 6. Testing and bug fixing. 7. Assistance with publishing the game. ### Before Starting, Please Tell Me: 1. Your total development cost. 2. Estimated delivery time. 3. Examples of multiplayer Roblox games you have developed. 4. Whether you will create custom 3D assets. 5. Whether the quoted price includes all three maps and all requested systems. 6. Whether you provide post-delivery bug support. Please provide a detailed quotation with milestones and payment terms. I want a high-quality, complete game that is ready for public release.

opportunities.title: Detailed 3D Front-Discharge Mixer
opportunities.description: I have a full set of reference photos of a front-discharge concrete mixer and I need them translated into a production-ready 3D asset. The goal is a fully detailed model—cab, wheels, drum, chute, visible hydraulics, ladders, even the hose couplings—so that I can generate high-resolution marketing imagery straight from the file. The final piece has to look great under studio lighting and hold up to close-up camera angles, which means clean topology, correct real-world scale, and PBR materials that mimic painted steel, rubber, glass, and galvanised fittings. I’m comfortable with any mainstream modelling tool (Blender, 3ds Max, Maya, SolidWorks) as long as the finished work can be exported to STL or 3MF and keeps the material assignments intact. Deliverables • One fully detailed, watertight 3D model of the mixer • Texture set (PBR, 4-8K) organised by material type • Two or three preset studio scenes so I can instantly render hero shots Acceptance criteria • No non-manifold geometry or flipped normals • Parts logically grouped and named for easy selection • Model opens at the correct scale (in metres) in Blender/Max without tweaks • Renders match or exceed photo clarity when placed in a simple three-point light rig Share any portfolio examples of heavy-equipment modelling when you reply; that will help me jump straight into awarding the project. I will be 3D Printing this on the FlashForge AD5X. I can do it in pieces if need be that need to be glued and constructed.

opportunities.title: Guía y tutoría MATLAB-EEGLAB
opportunities.description: Nunca he usado MATLAB, pero necesito ejecutar EEGLAB para analizar registros de EEG que ya tengo en formato EDF/BDF. Busco a alguien que primero investigue y documente cómo integrar correctamente MATLAB con EEGLAB en mi sistema y, después, me enseñe a utilizar el flujo de trabajo básico para: • Instalar y configurar MATLAB, las toolboxes necesarias y la versión más estable de EEGLAB. • Importar archivos EDF/BDF a EEGLAB sin pérdida de canales ni metadatos. • Aplicar pasos de limpieza esenciales (filtros, detección/rechazo de artefactos, ICA) sobre datos previamente adquiridos. • Ejecutar análisis estándar (marcar eventos, crear epochs, calcular ERPs o espectros de potencia) con scripts reproducibles. • Guardar y exportar resultados y gráficos para futuras publicaciones. Quiero un paquete que incluya: – Un documento paso a paso con capturas y fragmentos de código comentado. – Una breve guía de conceptos básicos de MATLAB orientados a EEGLAB (funciones, rutas, variables, scripts). – Al menos dos sesiones en línea en vivo donde revisemos la instalación y corramos un ejemplo real con mis datos. – Respuestas a preguntas posteriores por escrito mientras practico. Valoraré que la explicación sea clara para principiantes y que el código quede listo para escalar a análisis más complejos en el futuro.

opportunities.title: Earring Jewelry CAD Designer Needed
opportunities.description: I run a small line of sterling-silver jewelry and I’m looking for a reliable CAD partner who truly understands how pieces move from screen to casting bench. Most of the work in my queue is earrings—mainly eng-clasp and classic stud styles—featuring large lab-grown sapphires (round, oval, pear, and marquise). Here’s how we’ll work together: I supply precise stone measurements and a visual reference for the overall look; you decide the exact prong size, wall thickness, seat depth, and any extra structural bracing so the model survives casting and sets cleanly in 925 silver. An eye for real-world tolerances is critical—I’m after someone who thinks like a bench jeweler, not just a 3D artist. Typical payout for a straightforward design is in the $10–20 range. When a design is approved, I’ll need: • an editable Rhino 3DM file • a production-ready STL ready for print or CAM If this sounds like a fit, send over a few samples of past jewelry CAD work—finished renders, screenshots, or photos of cast pieces you’ve designed are all welcome. I review portfolios first, then we can move directly into the next earring assignment.

opportunities.title: Ice Cream Cafe Layout & Equipment
opportunities.description: I’m getting ready to build a medium-sized ice cream cafe—enough room for a service counter and a handful of tables—and I need a detailed layout and equipment plan that brings the space to life. Our menu is built around classic scoops and elaborate sundaes, so the floor plan has to guide guests smoothly from the entrance to the dipping cabinet, while keeping prep, storage and cleaning areas efficient for staff. You’ll start with my rough measurements and concept sketches, then translate them into a professional layout that a contractor and health inspector can read without questions. Think clear customer flow, logical placement of dipping cabinets, topping stations, POS, and a compact seating zone that still feels inviting. Behind the counter we’ll need room for freezers, refrigerated prep, dry storage, sink stations and all plumbing/electrical rough-ins. Please include: • Scaled floor plan (AutoCAD, SketchUp or similar) showing front- and back-of-house zones • Reflected ceiling or equipment power plan noting utilities for each appliance • Comprehensive equipment schedule with model suggestions, dimensions and spec sheet links • 3-D visual or mood board to illustrate customer experience (optional but preferred) I’ll provide local code notes, brand colours and inspiration photos once we start. If you’ve laid out cafés, dessert bars or quick-service spaces before, I’d love to see those samples. Let’s craft a shop that scoops fast, serves beautiful sundaes and keeps customers coming back for more.

opportunities.title: CAD Design for Car Vent Phone Mount
opportunities.description: Freelance CAD designer needed to turn a client's concept for a car air-vent phone mount into production-ready 3D files for functional 3D printing. This is a small plastic consumer accessory made of several parts that fit together. Full design details (concept drawings and how it works) will be shared only with the awarded freelancer, after signing a short NDA and IP assignment agreement. Please do not ask for them before award. Deliverables: - Complete 3D assembly plus each part modelled separately. - STEP and STL files for every part, print-ready (watertight, correct orientation). - Parametric native CAD source file (Fusion 360, SolidWorks, Onshape or similar) so dimensions can be adjusted after the first test print. - Designed for SLS/MJF printing in PA12 nylon, with engineering tolerances for fitting parts (clearances of about 0.3 to 0.5 mm) and suitable wall thickness. - Short note listing assumptions and dimensions to confirm. Please share relevant CAD experience with mechanical or consumer products, snap-fit or small assemblies, and print-ready design, with examples of past work. In your bid, tell us your price, timeline and CAD software. One round of revisions after the first prototype is expected.

opportunities.title: Smart Wearable Enclosure CAD Redesign
opportunities.description: The current enclosure of my wrist-worn smart device exists as a Fusion 360 assembly, but it still takes too many steps to put together on the bench. Your task is to refine that design so the next revision is straightforward to assemble and friendly to large-scale CNC machining. You will start by reviewing my existing Fusion 360 file, tightening the external form, re-laying internal PCBs, battery and sensors, and adding all mounting, snap-fit or screw bosses needed for a clean mechanical stack-up. My top priority is making the enclosure easier to assemble and manufacture, so every decision—from wall thickness and draft angles to fastener choice—should reflect Design for Manufacturing principles. Once the architecture is locked, I need fully detailed, tolerance-controlled documentation ready for both prototype CNC runs and future production. Deliverables • Fully parametric Autodesk Fusion 360 model of the complete enclosure assembly • CNC-ready 3D geometry and tool-path-friendly bodies • Formal DFM review with notes on machining, finishing and assembly flow • Tolerance-controlled 2D engineering drawings (Fusion 360 + PDF) • Neutral STEP files for downstream CAD and vendor use • PDF package of all finalized drawings and build documentation A background in compact electronics housings, precision mechanical design and production machining will make this go smoothly. If you are comfortable iterating quickly in Fusion 360 and can hand back a clean, organised data set that a CNC shop can quote immediately, we will be an excellent fit.

You will start by reviewing my existing Fusion 360 file, tightening the external form, re-laying internal PCBs, battery and sensors, and adding all mounting, snap-fit or screw bosses needed for a clean mechanical stack-up. My top priority is making the enclosure easier to assemble and manufacture, so every decision—from wall thickness and draft angles to fastener choice—should reflect Design for Manufacturing principles. Once the architecture is locked, I need fully detailed, tolerance-controlled documentation ready for both prototype CNC runs and future production. Deliverables • Fully parametric Autodesk Fusion 360 model of the complete enclosure assembly • CNC-ready 3D geometry and tool-path-friendly bodies • Formal DFM review with notes on machining, finishing and assembly flow • Tolerance-controlled 2D engineering drawings (Fusion 360 + PDF) • Neutral STEP files for downstream CAD and vendor use • PDF package of all finalized drawings and build documentation A background in compact electronics housings, precision mechanical design and production machining will make this go smoothly. If you are comfortable iterating quickly in Fusion 360 and can hand back a clean, organised data set that a CNC shop can quote immediately, we will be an excellent fit."

opportunities.title: Instructor Meta Ads para Curso Online
opportunities.description: Buscamos instructor de Meta Ads para desarrollar y grabar un curso online (básico a avanzado) Estamos buscando una persona con experiencia en Meta Ads (Facebook e Instagram Ads) que pueda desarrollar y grabar un curso educativo para nuestra academia. El objetivo es ofrecer a nuestros alumnos una formación práctica y completa que les permita aprender a crear, configurar, administrar y optimizar campañas publicitarias para sus propios negocios. Nuestros alumnos incluyen emprendedores, propietarios de pequeños negocios, profesionales independientes, estudios de belleza, spas y negocios locales que desean aprender a promocionar sus servicios mediante publicidad digital. ¿Qué necesitamos? Una persona que pueda: - Desarrollar un programa de formación desde nivel básico hasta avanzado. - Explicar paso a paso cómo utilizar el Administrador de anuncios de Meta. - Enseñar a crear campañas desde cero para Facebook e Instagram. - Explicar los objetivos de campaña, públicos, segmentación y presupuestos. - Enseñar a configurar anuncios, imágenes, videos y textos publicitarios. - Explicar cómo utilizar WhatsApp como destino para captar clientes. - Enseñar a revisar resultados, métricas y optimizar campañas. - Explicar cómo organizar campañas y administrar diferentes cuentas publicitarias. - Incluir ejemplos prácticos enfocados en pequeños negocios y servicios locales. Requisitos del instructor: - Experiencia demostrable trabajando con Meta Ads. - Capacidad para enseñar de manera clara, organizada y sencilla. - Hablar español. - Contar con equipo adecuado para grabar clases (micrófono, computadora y buena calidad de audio y video). - Tener conocimientos para grabar tutoriales de pantalla y explicar los procedimientos paso a paso. - Poder entregar las clases grabadas y organizadas por módulos. Modalidad del proyecto: Buscamos desarrollar un curso autograbado, dividido en módulos y lecciones, para que los alumnos puedan acceder al contenido y avanzar a su propio ritmo. Presupuesto: Actualmente no tenemos un presupuesto fijo establecido. Nos gustaría conocer las propuestas económicas de los interesados. Si estás interesado, puedes dejarnos en los comentarios tu presupuesto aproximado, una breve descripción de tu experiencia y algún ejemplo de cursos o trabajos que hayas realizado. Posteriormente, nos pondremos en contacto para explicar mejor el proyecto, definir el contenido, la cantidad de módulos, los entregables y acordar una estructura de pago. Le dejamos una pequeña referencia en imagen ¡Esperamos conocer tu propuesta!

opportunities.title: Telugu-English Learning Cartoons Creation
opportunities.description: I’m getting ready to launch “Happy Kids World” and need a creative partner to produce a series of short Telugu-and-English cartoons that help young children aged 5–7 master their letters, numbers, and first words. Each video should balance clear educational moments with the colour and energy that keeps kids giggling, singing along, and—most importantly—learning. You’ll handle the full pipeline—concept, script, voice-over (both languages), animation, sound, and final mastering—so our channel can upload finished episodes on a consistent schedule. The visual style should feel warm, friendly, and easy for children to follow; think bright characters, simple shapes, and lots of repetition that reinforces the alphabet and counting without ever feeling like homework. When you reply, focus on your experience creating educational or children’s animation. Links to completed projects that show bilingual content, early-literacy themes, or a comparable art style will help me see the fit quickly. If you have a preferred workflow or toolset (Toon Boom, Adobe Animate, Blender, After Effects, etc.), mention it so we can align on files and formats from day one. I’m excited to build a long-term collaboration that keeps kids around the world learning, laughing, and playing—starting right here in both Telugu and English.

opportunities.title: Bilingual L1 Support Agent
opportunities.description: Serás mi punto de contacto de nivel 1 para atender a colaboradores en toda Latinoamérica de forma remota a través de chat, correo y, cuando haga falta, llamadas breves. Las conversaciones se darán tanto en español como en inglés, por lo que necesito que puedas cambiar de idioma con soltura según el usuario. Tipo de consultas La mayoría de los tickets giran en torno a dudas sobre el uso de nuestras propias herramientas y procesos internos. Esto incluye guiar al usuario paso a paso, compartir pantallazos o enlaces a la base de conocimiento y dejar registro claro en el sistema de tickets. Cuando el problema exceda tu alcance de L1, simplemente tomarás los datos, documentarás lo hecho y lo escalarás. Entorno técnico Trabajamos principalmente con Microsoft 365: Outlook, Teams y las aplicaciones de Office en la nube. Necesito que ya las manejes o aprendas rápidamente sus configuraciones básicas, permisos y paneles de administración más comunes. El acceso remoto y el sistema de tickets te los proporcionaré el primer día junto con un recorrido por nuestra documentación interna. Entregables • Resolver o escalar cada ticket siguiendo el SLA acordado. • Registrar notas claras y completas en la plataforma de soporte. • Proponer mejoras o artículos cortos para la base de conocimiento cuando detectes preguntas repetidas. Si dominas la comunicación bilingüe, te mueves con soltura en Microsoft 365 y disfrutas de ayudar a usuarios a entender herramientas y procesos, avísame y coordinamos una breve entrevista técnica.

opportunities.title: Comercial Servicios Tecnológicos Navarra
opportunities.description: En Nafarsare (Pamplona-Iruña) ayudamos a pymes, autónomos y asociaciones de toda Navarra, y sobre todo de zonas rurales, a ordenar su parte tecnológica. Hacemos páginas web, soporte informático, automatizaciones y apps de gestión a medida sobre Google Sheets: control de socios, cobros, reservas, inventario… Buscamos comerciales autónomos que nos presenten a negocios y entidades que puedan necesitarnos. Qué harás Detectar empresas, comercios y asociaciones con procesos manuales (Excel, papel, WhatsApp…) Hacer el primer contacto y conseguir una reunión o un presupuesto [Opcional: acompañar en la reunión o cerrar la venta] Qué ofrecemos 10 % de comisión sobre cada proyecto vendido, pagado al cobrar el cliente. 5 % recurrente durante 12 meses en los servicios con cuota mensual (mantenimiento, soporte, hosting) Formación sobre nuestros servicios, argumentario, casos reales y apoyo técnico en las reuniones Libertad total de horario y 100 % remoto, con reuniones presenciales opcionales en Navarra Colaboración mercantil, sin exclusividad Qué buscamos Experiencia en venta B2B o una buena red de contactos en Navarra (gestorías, comercios, asociaciones, ayuntamientos…) Se valorará el euskera Alta como autónomo o posibilidad de facturar Si te interesa, escríbenos a info@ nafarsare.com contándonos tu experiencia y qué tipo de clientes conoces.

opportunities.title: Servicios Legales Integrales para Protección de Contenido Digital y...
opportunities.description: Se busca un profesional o despacho legal especializado para gestionar de principio a fin la protección de contenido digital y la lucha contra la piratería de cursos online de nuestros clientes. El alcance del proyecto incluye: - Gestión de requerimientos y acciones de retirada de tiendas y sitios web que distribuyen o regalan cursos de forma ilegal. Esto implica contactar al infractor, al proveedor de alojamiento, al registrador del dominio, a Cloudflare y a la pasarela de pago. - Eliminación de contenido distribuido ilegalmente en canales y grupos de Telegram, así como en perfiles de redes sociales. - Obligar a la retirada de contenido específico de nuestros clientes, incluso si la web o el canal infractor permanece activo. - Iniciación de acciones legales, tanto por vía penal como civil, contra aquellos que no cumplan con las solicitudes de retirada o reincidan, en el país donde se encuentren, llevando el caso hasta su resolución final. El cliente proporcionará la detección de las infracciones, las pruebas necesarias y los informes técnicos. El profesional legal se encargará de la firma de documentos, la presión legal y la interposición de denuncias. Requisitos imprescindibles. Abogado/a colegiado en ejercicio (indica país, colegio y número). Práctica real en propiedad intelectual o delitos informáticos: cuéntanos dos casos de retirada o denuncia y cómo acabaron. Capacidad para denunciar fuera de tu país, con tu propia red de corresponsales. Tenemos casos abiertos ahora mismo en Perú, México y Colombia. No buscamos servicios de envío masivo de avisos dmca ni perfiles de cumplimiento normativo o rgpd sin práctica en propiedad intelectual. Cómo trabajaremos. Relación estable: cuota mensual para las retiradas y honorarios aparte por cada denuncia. Indica tu tarifa para cada parte y en cuánto tiempo mandarías el primer requerimiento. Para descartar respuestas automáticas, empieza tu propuesta contándonos el último sitio o canal pirata que conseguiste cerrar. Categoría: Legal Tiempo requerido: De 5 a 20 horas

opportunities.title: Captador/a de propietarios en Madrid – gestión de alquileres (remot...
opportunities.description: H50 HOMES, una empresa española en expansión especializada en la gestión de alquileres, busca un/a captador/a de propietarios para unirse a su equipo de forma remota. El objetivo principal es identificar y contactar a propietarios particulares en Madrid para incorporar sus propiedades a la cartera de la empresa. Se busca una persona responsable, organizada y orientada a resultados, con el fin de establecer una relación de colaboración estable y a largo plazo. Funciones principales: - Búsqueda activa de propietarios particulares a través de portales inmobiliarios como Idealista, Fotocasa y otros. - Creación y mantenimiento de una base de datos de propietarios potenciales, incluyendo el filtrado de anuncios relevantes. - Realización del primer contacto con los propietarios mediante llamadas telefónicas, WhatsApp o mensajería de los portales, utilizando el argumentario proporcionado por la empresa. - Seguimiento de los propietarios interesados hasta que sean transferidos a la Dirección para el cierre del acuerdo. - Registro detallado de todos los contactos y oportunidades generadas, así como la elaboración de informes regulares sobre los resultados obtenidos. Condiciones del proyecto: - Modalidad 100% remota. - Dedicación de 6 horas diarias, de lunes a viernes, preferiblemente en horario partido (3 horas por la mañana y 3 horas por la tarde). - Las franjas horarias más efectivas para realizar llamadas son a partir de las 10:30 am y las 5:00 pm (hora de españa). - Se requiere compatibilidad horaria con España. Es posible compaginar con otros proyectos siempre que se cubra el horario íntegramente. Retribución: - Un fijo mensual de 300 EUR. - Un variable de 75 EUR por cada piso captado e incorporado a la cartera (una vez que el propietario firma el contrato de gestión). - Posibilidad de un BONUS adicional por volumen mensual. - El pago se realizará mensualmente mediante factura o documento de cobro como profesional independiente. - Existe la posibilidad de ampliar las horas y la retribución en función de los resultados obtenidos. Requisitos del perfil: - Español nativo o con un nivel muy alto, con excelente dicción y claridad al hablar. - Experiencia previa demostrable en ventas, teleoperación, captación de clientes o atención al cliente. - Comodidad y soltura en la realización de llamadas comerciales. - Manejo fluido de herramientas como Google Sheets/Excel, WhatsApp y correo electrónico. - Disponibilidad estable y capacidad para emitir factura en su país de residencia. - Se valorará positivamente la experiencia en llamadas en frío, conocimiento del sector inmobiliario, uso de Idealista, experiencia con clientes españoles y manejo de Crm. al postularte, cuéntanos tu experiencia, un ejemplo concreto de captación o llamadas en frío con su resultado, tu país y ciudad, tu disponibilidad y por qué buscas un proyecto a largo plazo. Categoría: Marketing Digital y Ventas Subcategoría: Televentas Tiempo requerido: Más de 20 horas

opportunities.title: 5-inch Human Figure 3D Model
opportunities.description: I have a single reference photo of a person and I need it turned into a 5-inch 3D printable figure. The finished file must capture a highly realistic likeness with fine surface detail, and the full-body pose and proportions must match the photo exactly. Please sculpt, retopologize, and deliver a watertight file ready for FDM or SLA printing (STL or OBJ preferred). Keep wall thicknesses and overhangs print-friendly for a figure that will scale to 5 inches tall without losing detail. I will provide the image once we start; feel free to ask for any extra angles you might need before sculpting. When you send the final file I’ll run a quick mesh integrity check and slice preview—once it passes without errors, the job is complete.
opportunities.contractor_info: Demandante verificado en Freelancer.co (Anuncio #40817682, publicado hace 1 día). Presupuesto ofrecido: INR 600 - 1,500.

opportunities.title: App Gestión Documental Integral -- 2
opportunities.description: Necesito desarrollar una aplicación empresarial que centralice toda la gestión documental y los procesos de atención al cliente de una distribuidora eléctrica. El primer hito debe ser un módulo de Atención al Cliente y Call Center totalmente operativo. Prioridad inicial • Registrar solicitudes, quejas y reclamos en tiempo real. • Consultar de inmediato el historial del cliente con sus contratos y pagos. • Asignar cada caso a un agente y hacerle seguimiento hasta su cierre, con alertas de estatus. Al completarse ese módulo, la misma plataforma deberá abarcar: – Gestión y archivo digital de contratos, expedientes y documentos legales. – Organización de facturas, recibos y comprobantes de pago. – Control de informes técnicos, órdenes de trabajo y planos. – Cobros en cajas, conciliación de pagos y reportes. – Paneles internos de reportes y métricas operativas. Requiero código fuente bien documentado, base de datos estructurada para búsqueda ágil y una interfaz web responsive (framework a tu elección mientras garantice escalabilidad y buenas prácticas). Valoro integraciones estándar (REST, OAuth) y un flujo de despliegue que permita pruebas continuas. Indica tu experiencia en proyectos similares y la metodología que aplicarías para entregarme primero el módulo de atención y luego el resto de la solución.
